description: Traverse explicit incoming, outgoing or bidirectional edges around one exact canonical graph node. An optional relation filter narrows the edge vocabulary. Traversal is descriptive only and does not infer truth, causation, importance or authority.

direction.description: Edge direction relative to node_id; defaults to both.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching graph edges to return.

node_id.description: Exact typed ZenithEye graph node ID whose neighbourhood should be traversed.

relation.description: Optional exact ZenithEye relation identifier such as traversesAxis or inhabitsField.

name: knowledge_graph_neighbors
title: Traverse ZenithEye Knowledge Graph
